text:
alice: Following up from the DR postmortem earlier — compiling action items. Posting owners/timelines here. Please react with :white_check_mark: if you accept. Items:
1) fix multi-region routing failover TTLs and routing policy
2) automated backup verification for region-b
3) restore runbook refinement + dry-run schedule
4) schedule quarterly DR game day
Need owners by EOD.

ben: I'll take #1 (routing) — aim to have config PR and smoke tests by next Tue. cc @carla for infra changes.

carla: Ack. I'll help with smoke tests. For routing change we need a canary plan — proposing: rollout to staging, then 2 lower-traffic regions, then global. I'll draft the plan in #eng-infra.

dan: I'll own #2 backup verification. Plan: daily snapshot verification job + weekly restore test. ETA: two sprints. Filing JIRA: INFRA-4321.

alice: Thanks. @dan add the verification logs to S3 with lifecycle retention 90d. Also update the SLAs doc.

emily: I'll rework the restore runbook (#3) — add step-by-step for cold restores and DB replay. Suggest a dry-run next Fri 14:00 UTC. :calendar:

ben: Can we automate db-binlog extraction? I have a small script: `tools/binlog_replay.sh` — will open PR.

incident-bot: created followup epic 'regional-failover-hardening' -> https://go/epic/REG-DR-2026

carla: For game day (#4) — recommend 2-hour window, pair with oncall + platform team. I can coordinate invites and game scenarios. Prefer week of Apr 12.

dan: Quick question — who will maintain the restore runbook after emily updates it? Need a long-term owner.

emily: Happy to be runbook lead for the first 3 months. We'll assign permanent owner during the retro.

alice: Action owners summary: #1 ben+carla (deadline: next Tue), #2 dan (2 sprints), #3 emily (dry-run Fri 14:00 UTC), #4 carla (week of Apr 12). I'll add to the tracking doc and ping weekly. :thumbsup: 

ben: Added a PR note, will post progress updates in #eng-runtime.

emily: Also adding a checklist to the runbook: prechecks, restore steps, post-validate commands. Example post-validate: `curl -f https://api.redwood.example/health || exit 1`

alice: Great. Closing the loop — please update the JIRA tickets and mark blockers here. I'll run a 1:1 with infra leads tomorrow. :eyes:
